scope: A02 operational followup of exhausted dispatch search

implementation.discovery: Existing scheduled integration worker, indexed no_driver_available query; strong source reread and conditional writes
implementation.activeInbox: staging-PlatformStaff: DISPATCH_FOLLOWUP_INBOX#OPEN queried by partition; no scan of staff audit or all orders
implementation.caseRecord: DISPATCH_REVIEW#<caseId> / FOLLOWUP, isolated per dispatch cycle
implementation.ownership: Self-claim, note and release under live regional orders.assign, employee version, recent authentication and MFA; revoked/unavailable owners may be replaced with an owner-profile guard
implementation.deadlines: Default review 5 minutes, escalation 15 minutes; policy copied to new cases only, never extended by claim or note
implementation.policy: Central settings /staff/settings/dispatch-followup uses the existing settings request/approval or DIRECT workflow
implementation.notice: Persistent in-platform banner on authenticated platform pages, scoped by live order region; no email/SMS/mobile push claim
implementation.resolution: Only on authoritative assignment, durable DISPATCH_RESTART STARTED acknowledgement, terminal order or source closure; financial case and compensation closure remain independent
implementation.ui: Existing order management button retained; actual SEARCH_RESUMED / DRIVER_ASSIGNED / ORDER_CLOSED states; review refresh pauses for typed notes
implementation.discoveryBudget: Up to 5 indexed pages per source per existing one-minute tick, 50 items/page with remaining-time stop and durable cursor
implementation.pendingRestart: A decision atomically seeds a notice if discovery has not run; queued, unconfirmed or failed restarts keep the original owner and deadlines until durable STARTED acknowledgement.

testMaintenance: The older full-cash retry fixture requested recovery at the first wave timeout. It now advances its synthetic clock to the original cycle search deadline, preserving all financial, funding-revocation and duplicate-offer assertions. Both tests pass; production search timing was not changed.
pendingLimits: Human multi-account and actual fresh order acceptance remains queued, not marked PASS
Automated discovery targets search exhaustion; the existing acceptance/reservation review remains available with manual followup controls
Record retention and deletion coverage stays within the existing X02 audit; no automatic retention duration or TTL was invented
